title: Despise
summary: DESPISE, .verb intransitive 1. To contemn; to scorn; to disdain; to have the lowest opinion of. Fools despise wisdom and instruction. Proverbs 1:7. Else he will hold to the one, and despise the other.

inlines.v: DESPISE, .verb intransitive 1. To contemn; to scorn; to disdain; to have the lowest opinion of. Fools despise wisdom and instruction. Proverbs 1:7. Else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Matthew 6:24. 2. To abhor.
